value.rationale: The classical uniform random-mapping null has two natural observables with different uses: eventual iteration (cyclic core) and image loss/terminal sites. Their complete conditional bivariate mass function, exact factorial moments, strict regression valid for every increasing transform of cyclic count, and finite/asymptotic covariance calibrate dependence not specified by marginal laws. The occupancy equivalence is a structural connection requiring a rooted-forest minor and factorial inversion. It is motivated and usable even without a paper-sized downstream theorem.
